title: Phenol Chloroform DNA Extraction from Polycarbonate Filters
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ibbcain
materials: Put filter into sterile polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Sample
steps.instruction: If not using a whole filter, aseptically cut out a piece (e.g. 1/2) of a filter.

substeps.instruction: Dip steel forceps and scissors into 95% ethanol, then flame forceps; repeat twice for aseptic technique.

steps.title: Initial Lysis Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample tubes on ice and add lysis buffer.

steps.title: Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Massage the filter with a flame-sterilized glass rod to suspend all cells from the filter.

steps.title: Lysozyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Add lysozyme from a 100 mg/mL stock to a final concentration of 1 mg/mL and incubate for 20 minutes at 37ºC (ideally on a shaker, otherwise a water bath).

steps.title: Proteinase K and SDS Treatment
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K and SDS to the sample and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (20 mg/ml stock solution) to a final concentration of 50 μg/ml.
Add 10% SDS to a final concentration of 0.5%.
Incubate 2 hours at 50ºC (ideally on a shaker, otherwise a water bath).

steps.title: Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the following steps in a fume hood: add saturated phenol (1/2 of the total aqueous volume), cap tubes tightly, shake well, and let sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Chloroform Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform isoamyl alcohol (2.5 mL), shake well, let sit for 5 minutes, and centrifuge for 1 minute at maximum speed on a tabletop centrifuge.

steps.title: Aqueous Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous (top) layer into sterile Oak Ridge tubes.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using ethanol and ammonium acetate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2x the aqueous volume of ice cold absolute ethanol.
Add 0.1x the total volume of 10 M ammonium acetate.
Mix contents and place tubes in -20ºC freezer for at least 1 hour or overnight.

steps.title: Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 10,000 rpm for 35 minutes to pellet the DNA.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Carefully wash the DNA pellet with 1 mL of ice-cold 70% ethanol.

steps.title: DNA Drying
steps.instruction: Remove the 70% ethanol and place tubes in a sterile hood to let DNA pellets dry for 2-3 hours until completely dry.

steps.title: Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and measure its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend DNA into 200 μL of sterile TE buffer (pH 8).
Measure DNA concentration using a spectrophotometer and/or fluorometer.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the DNA in a -20ºC freezer.
